title: Number of plumbing fixtures.
officialText:
For prior code buildings, the number of required plumbing fixtures shall be
permitted to be calculated based on the 1968 Building Code utilizing the occupant load figures from the 1968 Building Code,
or shall be permitted to be calculated based on the New York City Plumbing Code utilizing the occupant load figures from the
New York City Plumbing Code.
